name: Supplying the Sepulcher
summary: At the Sepulcher, Deathguard Podrig seeks arms for a garrison worn down by the fighting. He sends an order to the Undercity as beasts, Scourge and other threats drain its stores.

sections.title: Arming the Front Line
sections.body: Deathguard Podrig says the Sepulcher has fair stores, yet fighting in Silverpine Forest steadily uses them up. Feral beasts, Scourge remnants and other local threats damage weapons and armor or leave them behind after skirmishes. Under Executor Hadrec's orders, Podrig writes a request to Gordon Wendham, a weapon dealer in the Undercity. Replacement arms and armor help the Forsaken hold their fragile footholds beyond Tirisfal Glades.

sections.title: The Flight Network
sections.body: Silverpine's roads make a slow and dangerous way to carry vital messages and supplies. So the Forsaken send them by trained vampire bats. At the Sepulcher, Karos Razok handles the bats and links its soldiers to the Undercity's aerial network. Those routes connect outlying garrisons to Sylvanas's capital.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Podrig's order?
faq.answer: Executor Hadrec ordered Deathguard Podrig to request weapons for the Sepulcher. General supplies were sufficient, but arms were needed to replace those broken or lost in fights with the Scourge and other forest threats.
Gordon Wendham is a weapon merchant in the Undercity. Podrig addresses the Sepulcher's request for new arms to him.
Karos Razok handles the bats at the Sepulcher. He oversees the dread bats that carry messengers, scouts and supplies across Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why use bats instead of road couriers?
faq.answer: Silverpine Forest's roads are dangerous, with hostile beasts, Scourge and other factions threatening couriers. Bat routes offer a faster and safer connection to the Undercity.

faq.q: What threats does the Sepulcher face?
faq.answer: The Sepulcher faces lingering Scourge undead, worgen, wild beasts and regional human factions. The garrison needs steady replacements to remain ready for battle.

faq.q: Where does this task lead next?
faq.answer: Karos Razok can arrange flight transport to the Undercity, where the requisition is addressed to Gordon Wendham.

angles.text: As an Undead, you help maintain Forsaken outposts like the Sepulcher. They extend Forsaken reach beyond Tirisfal Glades and secure the surrounding wilderness for the Dark Lady.
As a member of the Horde, you rely on flight routes between garrisons and capital cities to coordinate defense across contested regions.
